title: Superseded: New York City ZIP Code Geometry (Use nycmaps)
text: Superseded. Use nycmaps package instead. two objects package used provide nycmaps, contents: nycmaps::nyc_zips: New York City ZIP codes borough, county, post office. nycmaps::nyc_zip_sf: ZIP code tabulation area polygons 2019 ACS population, EPSG:2263 (copy formerly EPSG:4269). removed nyczips version 0.0.1.9001 loading packages longer masks one copy .
